headline: The work-breakdown-structure area covers creating and running team tasks from a plan, Excel import/export, AI-generated task breakdowns, and Kanban, calendar and graph status views; the code examined did not settle how much of this exists.
what_is_there: The files reviewed show closely related building blocks: an Excel template with import and export for account data, date-grid logic that could underpin a calendar view of scheduled tasks, and a holiday lookup. None of it directly demonstrates the task creation and execution flow, the AI-generated breakdown, the Kanban or graph views, or task dependencies.
what_is_unclear: Whether the ticket's features are built is unconfirmed — the analysis only saw a keyword-selected slice of the repository, and one referenced task-related file was never shown. One supporting document appears to describe a different system, so it was not relied on.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point to where task creation, the AI breakdown, and the Kanban/calendar/graph views live, and re-run the check against those areas.
caveat: One document cited as evidence appears not to describe this codebase, so it carries no weight here.
